title: China Reached 500 Nuclear Warheads As World Stockpiles Fell
hook: China reached 500 warheads while the world total kept shrinking.
closing: One growing arsenal makes future disarmament harder to predict.
question: Can nuclear stockpiles keep falling?

segments.say: The world once held 70,300 nuclear warheads. The global stockpile then fell sharply.
China reached 500 nuclear warheads. Its arsenal grew against the wider decline.
Russia holds 5,580 nuclear warheads. Established powers still dominate the balance.
